heading.en: Birth, marriage and the years as heir

body.zh-Hant: 阿爾貝1875年4月8日生於布魯塞爾，父親是法蘭德斯伯爵菲利普，伯父是國王利奧波德二世。他就讀軍事學院，並在擲彈兵團長期服役。1900年10月2日他與巴伐利亞的伊莉莎白成婚。1907年利奧波德二世任命他為王國中將，讓他開始接觸國家事務。
body.en: Albert was born in Brussels on 8 April 1875, son of Philip, Count of Flanders, and nephew of King Leopold II. He studied at the Military Academy and served a long term in the Grenadiers Regiment. On 2 October 1900 he married Elisabeth of Bavaria. In 1907 Leopold II made him Lieutenant General of the Kingdom, introducing him to national affairs.

heading.en: Accession and the calm early reign

body.zh-Hant: 1909年12月17日利奧波德二世去世，阿爾貝於12月23日宣誓效忠憲法，成為比利時繼利奧波德一世、二世之後的第三位國王，並於當日隆重進入首都布魯塞爾。他接手的是一個富裕的國家，境內有佛拉蒙與瓦隆兩個社群，並擁有剛果殖民地。在位最初幾年相對平靜，比利時於1910年在布魯塞爾、1913年在根特舉辦大型國際博覽會。
body.en: Leopold II died on 17 December 1909, and on 23 December Albert took the constitutional oath, becoming the third king of the Belgians after Leopold I and Leopold II, and made his solemn entry into Brussels. He inherited a prosperous country with two communities, Flemings and Walloons, and a rich colony, the Congo. The first years of his reign were relatively calm, and Belgium held large international exhibitions in Brussels in 1910 and in Ghent in 1913.

heading.zh-Hant: 第一次世界大戰與統帥全軍
heading.en: The First World War and command of the army

body.zh-Hant: 德國要求軍隊自由通過比利時領土，阿爾貝1914年拒絕了這份最後通牒，比利時於8月4日遭入侵。8月5日他親自統帥全軍，10月決定在伊瑟河沿線守住比利時的國土。戰時王室駐在海濱的拉潘，國王甚至深入戰壕指揮部隊。他等到1918年才發動他認為可行的攻勢，11月22日勝利的軍隊進入解放後的首都，國王騎馬走在隊伍最前。
body.en: In 1914 Albert rejected the German ultimatum demanding free passage of German troops across Belgian territory, and Belgium was invaded on 4 August. On 5 August he personally took command of the armed forces, and in October he decided to hold ground on Belgian soil along the Yser River. During the war the royal couple lived at La Panne on the coast, and the king went down into the trenches to lead his army. He waited until 1918 to launch an offensive he thought feasible, and on 22 November the victorious army entered the liberated capital with the king riding at its head.

heading.en: Postwar years and death in a climbing fall

body.zh-Hant: 戰後阿爾貝在國會的著名御座演說中向伊瑟河部隊致敬，並宣布設立荷語大學與引進男子普選。1919年他訪問美國，1928至1932年再度前往剛果。他熱愛登山，1934年2月17日在那慕爾附近的馬爾什萊達姆攀岩時身亡；其子利奧波德（後來的利奧波德三世）自1934年起為王。
body.en: After the war Albert, in his famous throne speech to Parliament, paid tribute to the Yser troops and announced a Dutch-speaking university and universal male suffrage. He visited the United States in 1919 and returned to the Congo between 1928 and 1932. A keen mountaineer, he died on 17 February 1934 climbing at Marche-les-Dames near Namur; his son Leopold, later Leopold III, was king from 1934.

people.name: Ricardo Jiménez Oreamuno
people.nameZh: 里卡多·希門內斯·奧雷亞穆諾

body.zh-Hant: 里卡多·希門內斯·奧雷亞穆諾1859年2月6日生於哥斯大黎加的卡塔戈，1884年在聖荷西的聖多馬斯大學取得法學學位。次年他被任命為聖荷西市議會主席，並被派往墨西哥執行外交任務，爭取墨西哥支持哥斯大黎加對抗危地馬拉將軍巴里奧斯。
body.en: Ricardo Jiménez Oreamuno was born at Cartago, Costa Rica, on 6 February 1859 and took his law degree at the University of Santo Tomás in San José in 1884. The following year he was named president of the municipality of San José and sent on a diplomatic mission to Mexico, where he won Mexican support for Costa Rica against the Guatemalan general Justo Rufino Barrios.

body.zh-Hant: 1886年1月他在華盛頓發表〈卡塔戈學院〉一文，主張政教完全分離，使他成為哥斯大黎加「89世代」的自由派理論家。同年11月他獲任為內政、警政與公共工程部的國務卿，其後出任最高法院院長，1892年因反對羅德里格斯的獨裁而辭職。1906年他當選國會議員，並以批評聯合果品公司的優惠待遇而聞名。
body.en: In January 1886 he published the essay "Colegio de Cartago", arguing for complete separation of church and state, which made him a leading liberal theorist of the Generation of '89. In November 1886 he was appointed secretary of state in the Office of the Interior, Police and Public Works, and he later became president of the Supreme Court, resigning in 1892 in objection to the dictatorship of José Joaquín Rodríguez. In 1906 he was elected to Congress and made his name as the chief critic of the United Fruit Company's preferred economic status.

body.en: He was elected president on 7 April 1910 and served from 8 May 1910 to 8 May 1914. He rebuilt the city of Cartago after the earthquake of 1910 and decreed direct voting in 1913.

body.en: After a brief retreat from politics he was elected representative of the provinces of San José and Cartago in 1921. He was elected president again on 2 December 1923 and served from 8 May 1924 to 8 May 1928. He decreed the secret ballot in 1925, created the Banco Nacional de Seguros in 1926, now the Instituto Nacional de Seguros, and began electrifying the Pacific railway that year.

heading.en: Born a king and the regency

body.zh-Hant: 阿方索十三世1886年5月17日生於馬德里，出生即為國王，因為父親阿方索十二世在他出生前約六個月去世。母后瑪麗亞·克里斯蒂娜擔任攝政，直到1902年；他在1902年5月17日宣誓效忠憲法，被宣告成年。
body.en: Alfonso XIII was born in Madrid on 17 May 1886, already a king, because his father Alfonso XII had died about six months before his birth. His mother, Queen Maria Christina, ruled as regent until 1902; on 17 May 1902 he swore allegiance to the Constitution and was proclaimed of age.

body.zh-Hant: 1906年5月31日，他在馬德里與維多利亞·歐仁妮·巴滕貝格公主成婚。親政最初五年受兩大政黨內部危機所致的政治不穩所困，1907年安東尼奧·毛拉與塞希斯蒙多·莫雷分別接掌保守黨與自由黨領導權，危機才化解。1909年7月26日至8月2日巴塞隆納發生「悲慘一週」，自由黨領袖卡納萊哈斯則在1912年11月12日遇刺身亡。
body.en: On 31 May 1906 he married Princess Victoria Eugenie of Battenberg in Madrid. The first five years of his reign were marked by political instability from internal crises in the two leading parties, resolved in 1907 when Antonio Maura and Segismundo Moret took over the Conservatives and Liberals. The Tragic Week of Barcelona ran from 26 July to 2 August 1909, and the liberal leader José Canalejas was assassinated on 12 November 1912.

heading.zh-Hant: 大戰中立與安努瓦爾慘敗
heading.en: Wartime neutrality and the disaster at Annual

body.zh-Hant: 1914年7月第一次世界大戰爆發，西班牙保持中立。阿方索十三世為雙方戰俘的家屬轉遞詢問與金錢，成為戰俘的代言人，贏得廣泛國際聲譽。1921年7月22日安努瓦爾戰役的軍事慘敗，則引發廣泛的社會動盪與政府的困境。
body.en: World War I broke out in July 1914 and Spain remained neutral. Alfonso XIII became an advocate for prisoners of war on both sides, passing on inquiries and money for their families, which earned him wide international recognition. The military disaster at the Battle of Annual on 22 July 1921 then led to widespread social unrest and government difficulties.

heading.zh-Hant: 普里莫·德里維拉獨裁與其後
heading.en: The Primo de Rivera dictatorship and its aftermath

body.zh-Hant: 1923年9月13日至15日，普里莫·德里維拉將軍發動政變，阿方索十三世未予反對。獨裁持續到1930年普里莫下台為止，國王隨後任命達馬索·貝倫格爾將軍組閣，預備在舊的1876年憲法下舉行大選；最後一屆國王籌組的「集中政府」由海軍上將阿斯納爾主持，終告失敗。
body.en: General Miguel Primo de Rivera staged a coup between 13 and 15 September 1923, and Alfonso XIII did nothing to oppose it. The dictatorship lasted until Primo stepped down in 1930, after which the king named General Dámaso Berenguer to head a government meant to hold elections under the old constitution of 1876. The last of the king's concentration governments, presided over by Admiral Aznar, ultimately failed.

heading.zh-Hant: 共和國成立、流亡與去世

body.zh-Hant: 1931年4月12日的市政選舉結果被共和派、社會黨乃至部分擁護政權的政治人物視為對君主制的公投。阿方索十三世於4月14日離開西班牙，同日共和國宣布成立，他先後流亡法國與羅馬。1941年1月15日他放棄王朝權利，由其子巴塞隆納伯爵胡安繼承，並在同年2月28日於羅馬去世。
body.en: The municipal elections of 12 April 1931 were read by Republicans, Socialists and even some sympathisers of the regime as a referendum on the Monarchy. Alfonso XIII left Spain on 14 April 1931, the day the Republic was proclaimed, and went into exile in France and then Rome. On 15 January 1941 he renounced his dynastic rights in favour of his son Juan of Bourbon, Count of Barcelona, and he died in Rome on 28 February that year.
